resources.string: Accelerate the simulated clock from 1× to 3600×. The date advances automatically at midnight.
Choose how simulated time resumes when the app reopens. The selected speed applies in every mode.
Only while the app is active
Each fresh app launch restarts scenario time from its initial settings. While you use the app, it advances at the selected speed.
Scenario time advances at the selected speed only while you use the app. It pauses in the background and during the screensaver, then resumes where it stopped.
Scenario time keeps advancing at the selected speed even while the app is closed and after the phone restarts.
